description: Defines the Font class for character formatting in a paragraph within the MigraDoc Document Object Model, including properties like Name, Size, Bold, Italic, Underline, Color, Subscript, and Superscript, along with methods for applying font properties, cloning, and serialization.

classes.name: Font
classes.description: Represents character formatting in a paragraph, with properties for font attributes and methods for applying, cloning, and serializing font data.

classes.name: Font.FontValues
classes.description: Internal class holding nullable property values for Font, including Name, Size, Bold, Italic, Underline, Color, Superscript, and Subscript.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the Font instance.

methods.name: ApplyFont
methods.description: Applies properties from another Font object to this one, optionally considering a reference font.

methods.name: CheckWhatIsNotNull
methods.description: Returns a bitmask indicating which properties of the font are set.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Converts the Font object into a DDL string, considering the parent context and optional comparison font.
